manual.title: Fit the two suspension bands
manual.note: Use one Red and one Light Bluish Gray x37 medium round-section belt. Under the chassis, loop one around towballs #227 and #239; loop the other around #242 and #247. Keep each loop on its own side. Fit before the wheels.
manual.hold: Routing follows the reference suspension. The colored curves are routing guides; band tension, retention and loaded travel need a real-brick check.
manual.catalog_accessory: one Red and one Light Bluish Gray x37 medium round-section belt

manual.title: Fit the underside dishes
manual.note: Turn the chassis over for underside work.

manual.title: Add the rear socket plate and front lower tie
Install both floor plates
manual.note: Return the chassis to studs-up orientation. Support it underneath while pressing the plates.

manual.title: Build the bed floor and supports
Install the left side carrier
manual.note: Build this carrier separately, then lower it onto both floor supports. Align the two attachment points before pressing.
manual.hold: Support the chassis underneath. The complete side carrier must be attached before adding its outer body panels.

manual.note: Lower both long rails onto the side carriers and rear wheel arches.

manual.title: Fit the two round rear trims
manual.note: Fit these after the rear bed. They obstruct the bed brackets if installed earlier.

manual.title: Build the rear bumper strip layers
Finish the rear wheel-arch caps
manual.note: Face the closed rings outward, with their holes running along the truck. Fill the remaining stud with the Dark Orange tile.

manual.title: Finish the front wheel-arch caps
manual.note: Use the low, outward-facing rings and retain the smooth orange trim. Leave the holes accessible for threading.

manual.title: Fit the rear tailgate
manual.note: Bring the handles to the rear clips and check their movement.
manual.hold: Tailgate hinge insertion and clearance remain a test-build check.

instance_frames.title: Lay out the tailgate backing plates

frames.title: Lay out the tailgate backing plates

manual.title: Fit the lamp housings and lower slopes
Build the front grille
manual.note: Use four grille tiles; no grille sticker is required.

manual.title: Fit both curved bumpers and headlights
manual.note: Mount the clear 1 x 1 tile directly on the support, flush with the lower black tile. Mirror the rounded outer edge. Both clear lenses sit at the same height.

manual.title: Fit the dashboard, steering and seat
manual.note: Match the wheel angle shown; check free movement before closing the cab.
manual.hold: Seat-to-floor alignment is checked digitally. The optional driver is omitted; retain the seat and controls.

manual.title: Build the rear cab pillars and glazing
manual.note: Use two standard 1 x 2 bricks per pillar. Keep the cabin open above while fitting these panels.

manual.title: Tie and cap the rear cab frame
Fit the windscreen and roof support
manual.note: Keep the glazing clear of the dashboard while pressing it down.

manual.title: Fit the hood and upper tiles
manual.note: Snap the white 2 x 2 tile onto the hood rear centre studs. Add a Dark Orange 1 x 2 tile on each side, at the same height. Keep the original curved hood shell.

manual.title: Fit the removable white cab roof
Fit all four completed wheels
manual.note: Build four matching rim-and-tyre units. Align each rim with its wheel pin; do not bend the suspension to force it on.
manual.hold: Wheel-pin grip, tyre clearance and suspension motion remain physical checks.

instance_frames.title: Fit the tyre around the rim

frames.title: Fit the tyre around the rim

manual.title: Fit the four platform risers
manual.note: Make four matching two-plate stacks. Fit them to the bed before adding the platform.

instance_frames.title: Start with one black 2 x 2 plate

frames.title: Start with one black 2 x 2 plate

manual.title: Fit the tan rear platform
manual.note: Check engagement at all four risers.

manual.title: Fit the white enclosure mounting plates
manual.note: Fit both plates before the outboard rails.

manual.title: Fit the helm console
manual.note: Check that the wheel turns without touching the cab.
manual.hold: The spacer and bearing are digitally aligned. Test the ship-wheel fit and rotation before fitting the figure.

manual.title: Fit both side shield panels
manual.note: Keep each side panel one plate high. Slide inward from outside, then lower onto the studs. Keep the third panel for the front.

approach_frames.title: Hold the sides outside, one plate high
Slide inward, then lower onto the studs

manual.title: Fit the remaining front shield panel
manual.note: Use the third panel made earlier. Fit it before adding the tall flags.

manual.title: Fit the two outboard nautical rails
manual.note: Fit the rails after the panels, on the outer row of mounting studs.
manual.hold: Support the platform while pressing the rails; check their grip with real parts.

manual.title: Fit both roof speakers
manual.hold: The cones are aligned to the side studs. Their socket fit has geometry support but still needs a fitting check.

manual.title: Fit the sail mast and supports
manual.note: Use the bar stop at the support. This is the 4095 bar, not the tapered antenna.
manual.hold: Bar seating and clip grip have not been measured.

manual.title: Clip the flag to the mast
manual.note: The pointed end faces the rear. Keep the flag clear of both speakers.
manual.hold: The clip axes are vertical and aligned with the mast. Fit the horizontal-clip plates shown; grip and insertion still need a physical check.

instance_frames.title: Lay out the two Reddish Orange wedge plates
Tie both wedges with the smooth 2 x 2 tile
Fit both clips behind the wedges

frames.title: Lay out the two Reddish Orange wedge plates
Tie both wedges with the smooth 2 x 2 tile
Fit both clips behind the wedges

manual.title: Fit the rear mast foot and open-stud collar
manual.note: Stack the white round brick on the deck stud shown. Fit the jumper with its centre stud half a stud toward the rear, then add the open-stud round collar.

manual.title: Fit the rear mast and both flags
manual.note: Use the factory 10-stud rigid hose, with constant diameter along its length. Insert it into the open-stud collar; do not substitute the tapered antenna. Both flags trail toward the rear. Apply one character to each panel.
manual.hold: All four clip positions align with the constant-diameter mast. Test grip and handling with real parts.

manual.title: Fit both life rings
manual.hold: The mount-to-rail connection is digitally aligned. Test clip grip before moving the platform.

manual.title: Apply the hood sticker
manual.note: Use two clear films. H1 carries the whole upper character across the white centre tile and both level orange side tiles; do not cut at the internal tile seams. H2 carries the lower character and its straight white strip on the curved hood. Keep the two films separate at the change in surface height.

manual.title: Apply the individual banner stickers
manual.note: Upper panel: 洋. Lower panel: 流. Apply separate stickers to both sides, clear of the clips. The white flags carry printed Reddish Orange backgrounds, straight white strips and dark lettering.

manual.title: Apply the triangular flag tile sticker
manual.note: Use only the white SOON/順 emblem on clear film; the Reddish Orange tile supplies the background. Place it on the single smooth 2 x 2 tile, clear of the wedge seam.

manual.title: Fit the dangling decorative cord
manual.note: Thread about 0.6 mm cream craft cord through rings #25, #70, #142, then #78. Route the front outside the bumper. Tie the end knots after threading and leave slack between rings; cut extra for knots and trim after fitting. Keep clear of the wheels and lamps.

manual.title: Candidate minifigure
manual.note: Preassembled.

manual.title: Complete 小英 with the speech bubble
manual.note: One banner, two faces: 叫你休息 / 講不聽. Apply the jacket decal and both banner decals. Keep the figure beside the vehicle.

manual.title: Place the figures in the final scene
manual.note: Place the candidate at the helm. 小英 stands beside the vehicle.
